fact_text: Cozy is a clothing brand founded in early 2024 that the founder said is fully bootstrapped, funded by family members with no external investors.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: Cozy's range is knitwear only, mainly elevated basics such as hoodies, sweatshirts, oversized t-shirts, matching sets and polos for casual and business-casual wear.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy plans to add a rugby polo, then woven and formal wear, and to move into exports only once its production base is stable.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy competes on speed and quality rather than price, because brand trust with consumers is the core asset and cheap pricing invites returns and fraud.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy's near-term aim is to dominate the Pakistani apparel market, having sold very well in Karachi and expanding into Punjab.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder expected Cozy's prices to rise somewhat as the brand grows, with the extra budget put into marketing, R&D and the overall customer experience.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: Cozy's t-shirts cost about 3,500 rupees and its hoodies 5,000 to 6,000 rupees, which the founder called average pricing against other online brands.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said a fitness-brand t-shirt bought for about 3,000 rupees was, in his judgement, made for roughly 200 to 300 rupees, with weak stitching and a paper-like printed back.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said supplier quality is the hardest part of apparel, since weak makers deliver poor stitching, embroidery and printing even when their samples look good.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: A cap order placed with a supplier found by reference was lost: the supplier took the full advance and payment, then returned work with third-class embroidery and stitching.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: Cozy's first drop was 400 pieces; a supplier's poor cutting and finishing left all 100 white pieces with permanent wrinkles, so a quarter of the initial stock was lost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy's appearance at a Karachi fashion show, one week after its first drop, drew the highest footfall of any Cozy event to date and started organic community growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: A Cozy wellness collection sold out even though the founder's father disliked its designs, according to the founder.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy has sold very well in Karachi and has received a lot of orders from Punjab.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said Cozy has received orders from Europe, Spain and the US, plus a few from Brazil, and called the US and European markets the largest export opportunities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: Cozy sponsored an under-18 national swimming team for its nationals, supplying burgundy quarter-zip sets and bags for the team.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: A saying the founder cited holds that a brand can be faster, better or cheaper, but competing on cheapness brings returns, exchange and fraud problems.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder said manufacturers favour buyers who pay on time and share a long-term vision, so buyers should explain their brand plans to suppliers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)

fact_text: The founder described clothing as an evergreen need, like food and water, so apparel demand should keep rising with population growth.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The Accidental Entrepreneur: Ebrahim Kochra’s Journey to Scaling COZY | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-11-21)
